name: Jiangsu NanFang Precision Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu NanFang Precision Co.,Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells bearings and their related parts in China and internationally. The company offers needle bearing products; cylindrical and wedge clutch; and one way pulley OAP products. It also provides precision machined parts comprising pistons, such as EPB caliper piston, ESC plunger pump piston, ESC rubber coated rod, and EHB three-way valve; and internal spline ring, outer gear ring, outer groove ring, ferrule, leaf ring, and ball screw. The company's products are used in industrial, automobile, and motorcycle applications. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Changzhou, China.
